items.information: # **This is a series competition with [Ohio State Fall Scarlet 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateFallScarlet2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Ohio State Fall Scarlet 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected.** This competition will take place in the Great Hall Meeting Room, which is on the first floor near the east side. For those not competing in the 4BLD/5BLD, doors to the room will remain closed until the end of the event (10:20am EST), at which other competitors will be let in to set up.

items.information: ## The competition has been cancelled due to heavy rains. ### **This competition is a twin competition with Saturday. You will only be allowed to compete in one of the day.** * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation.

items.name: Talanga Open 2022
items.information: Talanga Open 2022 es una competencia que se realizara a 1 hora de la capital de Honduras, siendo apoyada por la alcaldia municipal del municipio de Talanga. Sera un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad. __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Talanga Open 2022 is a competition that will take place 1 hour from the capital of Honduras, being supported by the municipal mayor of the municipality of Talanga. It will be an event open to competitors of any nationality.
